draft_text: Ferrule generally achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT across the six-dataset tabular suite.
revised_text: Ferrule achieved a higher test AUROC than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets in the tabular suite (81.6 vs 80.9, 88.3 vs 87.1, 93.7 vs 92.8, 76.4 vs 75.6, 84.9 vs 84.1, 90.2 vs 89.0).
rationale: T1 shows Ferrule higher than Arbor-GBT on all six datasets (r1-r6). The claim's "generally" understates the complete evaluation; every dataset favors Ferrule. No statistical test is reported, so no significance claim is made.
